title: Fixed Sliding Window
summary: Reuse state between neighboring contiguous ranges of the same size by removing the outgoing item and adding the incoming item.
recognition_signals: candidate ranges are contiguous and all have the same size
the range statistic can be updated when one item leaves and one enters
core_rules: The maintained state must describe exactly the current fixed-size window.
After the first window is built, each shift removes one outgoing contribution and adds one incoming contribution.
structural_steps: build state for the first complete window
remove the outgoing item and add the incoming item

common_confusions.distinction: A fixed window has a prescribed size and moves by replacement. A variable window changes size to maintain a validity condition.
